source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: CallbackStreamListener.onDataAvailable remains an intentional error because the converter should consume message data. It reads URI.spec only when the request implements nsIChannel; otherwise it formats the request itself. This preserves the intended diagnostic instead of masking it with an undefined URI property error. Normal stop/finalization methods keep separate channel contracts, and this does not prove a channel with a missing URI is handled. No stream or indexing test ran.
title: Unexpected MIME data errors must not assume every request is a channel
